name: Four Seasons Istanbul, Sultanahmet
positioning: Small hotel in a former prison building in Istanbul's Sultanahmet district, steps from Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace and the Blue Mosque
Guests who prefer a small hotel of 65 rooms in a converted prison building

facts.text: The hotel has a total of 65 rooms.
The building was constructed as a prison from 1918 to 1919.
The building was converted to a Four Seasons hotel in 1996.
The hotel is just steps away from heritage sites such as Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern and the Blue Mosque.
The Grand Bazaar and the Spice Market are both only a mile away.
Avlu presents a contemporary interpretation of Anatolian cuisine.
The Rooftop has Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque on one side and the Marmara Sea on the other.
Kurna Spa offers guests the opportunity to try an authentic hammam experience.
Lingo Lingo's menu features fish, modern mezze and sustainable cocktails.
The press fact sheet describes an intimate hotel with rooms around an enclosed garden courtyard.

highlights.text: Avlu, the main restaurant, is set in the former exercise yard.
Condé Nast Traveler says one of the best upgrades following the hotel's pandemic redesign is the addition of a lovely hammam.
Condé Nast Traveler calls the Beyzade Suite, the former warden's room, the most unique room.
Condé Nast Traveler says the boat shuttle between the two Four Seasons properties gives guests a free Bosphorus cruise.
Since the rooms were carved out of former dormitories, they all have different shapes and feels.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says guests in the know head to the much more extensive spa at the Bosphorus hotel.
Pool access is at the sister property along the Bosphorus, reached by private land or sea transfer.
Linens and towels are not automatically changed daily; guests can place a special request card on the bed for a new set.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have smaller room sizes.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
